title: Message-board post claiming Puharich never died

tellings.quote: was somebody like, I know for a fact that Puharich never died and he was he was taken in by the government and

plain: Around 1995 someone on an online message board claimed that Andrija Puharich, a researcher of psychic phenomena, never died but was taken in by the government. An unnamed researcher on Michels's show says he came across the post himself, quoting it as saying 'I know for a fact that Puharich never died.' It is told as one of the strange rumours around Puharich's life.
